findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler no longer implements required abstract methods and will fail on instantiation
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler was changed from subclassing DetectorHandler (where it implemented `evaluate`) to subclassing StatefulDetectorHandler with just `pass`. StatefulDetectorHandler declares four abstract members that must be overridden: `counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and the newly added `build_occurrence_and_event_data`. Since none of them are implemented, calling `group_type.detector_handler(self)` in `Detector.detector_handler` (triggered from `process_detectors` for any Detector whose type is "metric_alert_fire") will raise `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class`. There is no try/except around handler construction or evaluation in `process_detectors`, so a single metric-alert detector in the input list will crash processing of the whole data packet. Either implement the abstract methods, or keep this handler on the non-stateful base until the abstraction is built.

findings.title: TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe builds the expected occurrence with the wrong group key
findings.body: In TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe, the expected occurrence is built via `build_mock_occurrence_and_event(handler, "val1", 6, PriorityLevel.HIGH)`, but the handler is then evaluated with group_key "group_key". `build_mock_occurrence_and_event` sets `fingerprint=handler.build_fingerprint(group_key)`, so the expected occurrence's fingerprint is `["<detector_id>:val1"]` while the actual result produced by `evaluate_group_key_value("group_key", ...)` will have fingerprint `["<detector_id>:group_key"]`. Since IssueOccurrence is a dataclass compared field-by-field, the `== expected_result` assertion on the DetectorEvaluationResult should fail (or, if it somehow passes, the occurrence payload is not actually being validated). The expected occurrence must be built with group_key "group_key" (and ideally the actual value passed to the evaluation, 10, instead of 6). The same pattern appears in test_state_results_multi_group, where the expected occurrence for "group_2" is built with value 6 although the packet contains 10 — this only passes because `value` is ignored by the mock builder, which means the tests don't actually verify the value is propagated to `build_occurrence_and_event_data`.

findings.title: Stale docstring: evaluate still documented as returning a list
findings.body: The docstring of StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate says "Evaluates a given data packet and returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`", but this PR changed the return type to `dict[DetectorGroupKey, DetectorEvaluationResult]`. The docstring should be updated so callers/subclass implementers are not misled about the contract (in particular that results are keyed by group key and duplicates are silently collapsed rather than logged, which was the previous behavior in process_detectors).
